introduction: Explore the bugger colony, meet its agitated Queen, and recover her two lost eggs and an abandoned carapace.
orientation: The colony connects with the underdark through its entrance and with a mossy tunnel through a hidden passage. Searching, opening a passage and crossing it are different actions.
Ask the Queen hello or agitated in her chamber. Hi is another greeting for the same conversation lead.

Several eggs look alike. Examine their descriptions: the lost egg and the misplaced egg are the two requested kinds. The tasty food egg from an attendant’s pouch is returned with a wrong-kind response.
The requested eggs are hidden room objects. Search the storage cavern and unfinished tunnels, then recover the exact eggs you find. Searching alone does not put an egg in your inventory.
The abandoned carapace is inside a dead bugger in the workers’ tunnel. Recover the contents; the body itself does not need to be carried or carved.
Carry the two distinct eggs and the carapace loose together before offering one to the Queen. Three copies of one egg, a held item or an item still inside a pouch do not prepare the complete set.
The Queen returns spiked carapace armor for the accepted set. Current item checklists change as items are spent, while recorded acceptance remains in the journal.

Sentinels, attendants, workers, caretakers, fungi, brood and slime pools describe a larger colony story. Caring for young, transporting eggs and resolving the colony’s threats need their own defined outcomes.

stories.title: Return the Queen’s lost eggs and abandoned carapace
stories.summary: Gather the lost egg, the misplaced egg and an abandoned carapace, then return the complete set for spiked carapace armor. The tasty food egg is a rejected offering, rather than a second quest.

steps.text: Carry the lost bugger egg loose
steps.hint: Search the storage cavern and examine the egg described as lost. Carry that exact egg loose; the tasty food egg and a second misplaced egg do not substitute for it.

steps.text: Carry the misplaced bugger egg loose
steps.hint: Search the unfinished tunnels and examine the egg described as misplaced. Carry that exact egg loose with the lost egg and carapace.

steps.text: Carry the abandoned bugger carapace loose
steps.hint: Look inside the dead bugger in the deep workers’ tunnel and recover the carapace. Carry it loose; you do not need to carry the body or carve a fresh kill.

steps.text: Record the Queen’s accepted eggs-and-carapace return
steps.hint: Carry both distinct requested eggs and the carapace loose together, then offer one to the Queen when present. The whole set is consumed for spiked carapace armor. Supplied exact items also fit; getting the reward and wearing it are later outcomes.

exclusions.reason: The Queen rejects food egg6402 and returns the same prototype kind. Preserve native settlement evidence without counting this wrong-egg response as a completed story, achievement or daily. Same-kind replacement is not proof of returning the same physical UID.
